lines.text: The writer calls with all his heart, rises before midnight to cry for help, and hopes in God's word.
The writer says those who follow wickedness draw near, but the LORD is near and all His commandments are true.
The writer asks for rescue because he has not forgotten God's law, and he has not turned from His testimonies.
The writer rejoices in God's promise like one who finds great spoil, and he praises God twelve times a day.
The writer says he has strayed like a lost sheep and asks the LORD to seek His servant.
